reason: The monoclinic cell is well supported by indexing (M(20)=68.1, F(20)=82.7) and Z=4 plus the broad borate chemistry are plausible, but exact recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory used a custom correlation-like profile objective with ad hoc bond restraints and an added low-angle cancellation penalty rather than a validated common-protocol refinement. The final selected model still calculates conspicuous reflections near 23.896 degrees (about 9% of the strongest calculated line) and 27.020 degrees (about 5%) where the measured pattern is flat at noise level; it also required deliberate suppression of an unobserved 14.724-degree line. The two submitted CIFs have the same cell, symmetry, element ordering, and nearly the same coordinate basin, so the alternative does not cover a materially distinct solution and in fact worsens the 14.724-degree mismatch. Thus the cell and an average framework may be supported, but P21/a, the coordinates, and especially the restraint-determined light-atom/Li-B ordering remain underdetermined; a scientifically motivated attempt testing distinct symmetry/order realizations and reporting a proper whole-pattern comparison could plausibly improve the candidate set.
